actionDesc: changes the brightness level of the selected group of wemo lights. if the group is off it will turn on with selected brightness level.
changes the brightness level of the selected wemo light. if the light is off it will turn on with selected brightness level.
sets sleep fader time for the selected group of wemo lights.
starts sleep fader for the selected wemo light.
this action turns off one of your light switches.
this action turns on one of your light switches.
this action well set a scene on your hue lights. note: in order to add lights to a room, you must be using the newest version of the hue app
this action will activate a scene.
this action will activate the scene that you choose. you can choose from any scene that is listed in your nanoleaf smarter series app.
this action will adjust multiple lights and shades together by activating a scene created in the lutron app.
this action will apply the settings of the selected scene to your wiz lights.
this action will briefly turn your hue lights off then back on.

this action will change the color of a light bulb.

this action will change the color of your hue lights to match the dominant colors found in an image you specify. note: not compatible with hue lux bulbs.
this action will change the color of your hue lights. note: accepts color names and css hex color values. defaults to white if no color match is found. note: not compatible with hue lux bulbs.
this action will change the color of your lights.
this action will change the color temperature of a light bulb.
this action will change your hue lights to a randomly selected color. note: not compatible with hue lux bulbs.
this action will change your light's brightness to the specified level.
this action will change your lights to a specified color.
this action will change your lights to specified color temperature.
this action will change your lights to the requested dynamic mode such as light flashing, jumping, gradual change and strobe.
this action will dim / brighten the selected light(s) by the step of your choice. ideal for your smart remotes, connected buttons, widgets and much more!
this action will dim or brighten your hue lights to a value between 0-100.
this action will make the selected light(s) pulse gently once.
this action will make your lights quickly blink the color of your choice.
this action will make your lights slowly breathe the color of your choice.
this action will set a dim level on your light.
this action will set the light to specified color.
this action will set your light to a specified brightness.
this action will set your lights to a pre-defined scene.
this action will set your lights to a specified brightness.
this action will switch off your light.
this action will switch on your light.
this action will temporarily set your nanoleaf light panels or canvas to a solid or blinking color and then return to its previous state.
this action will toggle a wemo light switch on or off.
this action will toggle your hive light on or off.
this action will toggle your hue lights on or off.
this action will toggle your lights on or off.
this action will turn a wemo light switch off then immediately back on.
this action will turn a wemo light switch off. if the wemo switch is already off, it will remain off.
this action will turn a wemo light switch on then immediately back off.
this action will turn a wemo light switch on. if the wemo switch is already on, it will remain on.
this action will turn off the functional light of your hood.
this action will turn off the nanoleaf product that you select from the device dropdown on this screen.
this action will turn off the selected light(s).
this action will turn off your hubitat switches, lights, sirens, strobes, etc.
this action will turn off your hue lights.
this action will turn off your sengled lights.
this action will turn on a slow color loop effect for your hue lights. note: not compatible with hue lux bulbs.
this action will turn on the ambient light of your hood with the selected color. please note that this action is not supported by all hoods.
this action will turn on the functional light of your hood with the selected brightness.
this action will turn on the nanoleaf product that you select from the device dropdown on this screen.
this action will turn on the selected light(s). optionally, a light mode or pre-defined color can be applied, as well as a level of dimming.
this action will turn on your hue lights.
this action will turn on your sengled lights.
this action will turn on, turn off or toggle your lights.
this action will turn on/off the led light of my projector.
this action will turn the specified product's night light off.
this action will turn the specified product's night light on.
this action will turn your hive light off for a specific duration
this action will turn your hive light on for a specific duration
this action will turn your lights off if they are on, and turn them on if they are off.

this action will turn your lights on.

turns off the selected wemo light. if it is already off it stays off.
turns on the selected group of wemo lights. if the group is already on it will remain on.
turns on the selected wemo light. if it is already on it stays on.
